source: Shandong province, action plan for a unified computing network, 2022 to 2025, as reported by Dazhong Daily on the provincial government's site
text: Shandong's action plan for a unified computing network, 2022 to 2025, as the provincial daily reported it: by 2025, home-made computing is to reach 90% in the province. The plan was released on Jul 31, 2022; the report is of Aug 1, 2022, on the provincial government's site. The plan's own text is not held.

source: Jiangsu province, plan for computing infrastructure issued by four provincial bodies (the saved PDF carries no date of issue)
text: Jiangsu's plan for computing infrastructure: home-made chips are to be 70% or more of the chips in use in newly built computing centres by 2030, and 50% by 2025. The plan's own table of indicators gives the line the values 50 for 2025 and 70 for 2030 and marks it "预期性" (expected, that is, indicative), not binding. The only line of that table marked "约束性" (binding) is the one on energy efficiency. The saved PDF carries no date of issue.
words: 新建算力中心国产算力芯片使用占比达 70%以上

source: Guangdong province, plan for computing infrastructure, 2024 to 2025, issued by the Guangdong Communications Administration and eight other bodies
text: Guangdong's plan for computing infrastructure, 2024 to 2025: strive for home-made computing to reach 70% of newly added computing by the end of 2025. It counts computing, not chips alone. Issued by the Guangdong Communications Administration and eight other bodies on Mar 7, 2024.
words: 力争到2025年底，新增国产化算力占比达到70%

source: Tianjin, plan for the computing industry, 2024 to 2026, issued by the city government's general office
text: Tianjin's plan for the computing industry, 2024 to 2026: by 2026, home-made chips are to be over 60% of the chips in use in the city's computing centres. It covers all the city's centres, not only new ones. The plan was written Jul 1, 2024 and issued Jul 18, 2024.
words: 全市算力中心国产算力芯片使用占比超过 60%

source: Hebei province, opinions of the provincial government's general office, May 8, 2024 (copy on the Xiong'an New Area's site)
text: Hebei's opinions on computing and the AI industry: by 2025, 60% or more of newly added basic software and hardware for computing is to be independently controllable. It counts software and hardware together, and its word is independently controllable, not home-made. The opinions are dated May 8, 2024; the saved copy is on the Xiong'an New Area's official site, which credits the provincial government's site.
words: 新增算力基础软硬件设施自主可控比例60%以上

source: Inner Mongolia autonomous region, work plan for the digital economy, 2023 to 2025, issued by the regional government's general office (Internet Archive capture of the official PDF)
text: Inner Mongolia's work plan for the digital economy, 2023 to 2025: by 2025, home-made computing is to reach 50% or more, among the goals for the region's part of the national computing network (its national hub). Issued by the regional government's general office, dated Oct 10, 2023. The saved copy is an Internet Archive capture of the official PDF.
words: 国产化算力占比达 50%以上

source: Shanghai's plan, as carried by the business daily Yicai
text: Shanghai's plan for 2024 and 2025: by 2025, home-made chips are to be over 50% of the chips in use in the city's newly built intelligent computing centres.
words: 到2025年,本市新建智算中心国产算力芯片使用占比超过50%

source: Sichuan province, action plan for computing infrastructure, 2024 to 2027
text: Sichuan's action plan for 2024 to 2027: strive for home-made computing equipment to exceed 50%. The wording is about equipment, not chips alone. The notice is dated Nov 15, 2024 and was published on Nov 22, 2024.
words: 力争国产化算力设备占比超过50%

source: National Development and Reform Commission and four other bodies, opinions of Dec 25, 2023
text: The national opinions on a computing network set no share for home-made chips. Their aim is worded without a number.
words: 算力网关键核心技术基本实现安全可靠

source: Shanghai Municipal Commission of Economy and Informatization, written reply dated Apr 30, 2025 (published Nov 10, 2025)
text: Shanghai's Commission of Economy and Informatization, in a written reply: internet companies' own computing clusters run mainly on Nvidia cards, and the three state telecom operators mainly buy Huawei and other home-made clusters. The reply gives no percentage.
words: 互联网企业自建算力集群,满足市场化企业需求,主要以英伟达高性能卡为主 / 三大运营商主要购置华为等国产化智算集群

source: Reuters, as carried by MarketScreener, reporting counts by the research firm IDC
text: The research firm IDC's count for 2025, as reported by Reuters: of about 4 million AI accelerator cards shipped in China, Nvidia had 55%, Chinese makers together 41% and AMD 4%.
words: Nvidia remained the market leader, shipping around 2.2 million cards and holding a 55% share. / Chinese vendors collectively shipped 1.65 million cards, accounting for 41% of the total market / shipping roughly 160,000 cards for a 4% share

source: Reuters, as carried by Mint (India), reporting counts by the research firm IDC
text: The same firm's count for January to June 2026, as reported by Reuters, which words it as China's market for data-centre AI chips: of 2.008 million AI accelerators shipped, Nvidia had 34% and Huawei 28%. Four more Chinese makers are named with 7%, 5%, 4% and 3%. The remaining 19% (our subtraction) is not broken down. The report gives no total for Chinese makers and does not mention AMD.
words: Nvidia's share of China's market for data-centre AI chips fell to 34% in the first half of 2026 / giving it a 28% share of the overall market / Alibaba's chip-design unit T-Head held 7%, followed by Cambricon with 5%, Baidu's Kunlunxin with 4% and Hygon with 3%.
